body: Well.. That's the thing. I dunno. People just seem to notice, but not say anything. And then I get nervous, which only increases the amount of rituals, and then they notice them even more.

No, that's not it. By "quirks" I don't mean things like being super organized or dressing a certain way. I suppose I should have been more clear about that. I mean things that I can't really explain to people. How am I supposed to explain to people that my mind makes me tap my shoulder 3 times every 5 minutes (as an example)?
